name: Okushiri (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Okushiri town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Okushiri, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1966.

features.role: Okushiri town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character
